title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Holding Limits per Customer
content:
**Credit standard — holdings per customer.** A customer may hold at most 2 Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts at a time, and never two of the same kind: at most 1 revolving card (Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Classic, Preferred or Premier) and at most 1 Ridgeline Project Loan (66, 78 or 84).

1. **Which accounts count.** An account counts toward the limit while its status is applied, active or suspended. Closed, declined and charged-off accounts do not count.
2. **One per kind at application.** A customer may not apply for a revolving card while another revolving card in their name is applied, active or suspended, and may not apply for a Project Loan while another Project Loan in their name is applied, active or suspended.
3. **No charged-off account.** No account in the customer's name may be in charged-off status when a new application is submitted.
4. **Changing revolving tier.** Moving to a different revolving tier is never done by opening a second revolving card; a cardholder who wants a different revolving tier closes the current card first or keeps it.

**Basis of judgement.** Each condition is read from the account records held in the customer's name — the tier and the status of every Ridgeline Consumer Credit account linked to that customer — as the system shows them before the application is submitted, not from the applicant's description of their accounts.

## Holding table (hypothetical portfolios)

| Accounts already in the customer's name | New revolving card application | New Project Loan application |
|---|---|---|
| Card Preferred, active | barred (a revolving card is active) | not barred by the holding rules |
| Project Loan 78, suspended | not barred by the holding rules | barred (a Project Loan is suspended) |
| Card Classic, closed | not barred by the holding rules | not barred by the holding rules |
| Card Premier, declined application | not barred by the holding rules | not barred by the holding rules |
| Card Classic, applied | barred (a revolving card is applied) | not barred by the holding rules |
| Project Loan 66, charged off | barred (an account is charged off) | barred (an account is charged off) |
| Card Premier active and Project Loan 84 active | barred | barred |

"Not barred by the holding rules" means only that these limits do not stand in the way; the application is still decided on its tier's entry requirements.
